Frequently Asked Questions

What will I learn from Retire Right, Retire Now?

You'll learn the five-pillar Retirement Money Map framework, including how to create reliable income streams, plan for healthcare costs, optimize taxes in retirement, protect against market volatility, design your estate plan, and ensure your money lasts throughout retirement.

Who is Retire Right, Retire Now for?

This book is for pre-retirees within 10 years of retirement, recently retired individuals, people with savings but no coordinated plan, and families seeking financial clarity. Whether you have $100,000 or $1 million saved, the principles apply.

Who is Mike Stevens?

Mike Stevens is a fiduciary financial advisor, President of Capital Wealth, and host of Retire Right Radio. With 25+ years of experience, he helps people transition from accumulation to distribution in retirement planning.

When will Retire Right, Retire Now be available?

Retire Right, Retire Now is scheduled for release in Spring 2026. You can get your free chapter now and be notified when the full book is available.

Is this book only for wealthy people?

No, the principles in Retire Right, Retire Now apply at any savings level. Good retirement planning is about percentages and strategies, not just dollar amounts. Whether you have $100,000 or $1 million saved, you'll benefit from the framework.
